title: OBLT AW agentic assets (apm.yml extension)
description: Extension block x-oblt-aw in consumer apm.yml. Each org key (e.g. obs, docs) owns common and workflows; workflow ids match config/<org-key>/workflow-registry.json. Use inner-workflows.<basename> when several control-plane wrappers share one registry id.

fragments.description: Local fragment id to repo-relative Markdown path.

common.description: Assets shared by all agentic workflows for this org when no workflow-specific block exists.

workflows.description: Per-workflow assets for this org. When a workflow id is present, common is ignored entirely (override). Prefer inner-workflows when wrappers share one id.

setup-commands.description: Inline shell commands (string or list). Multiline strings are split into one command per non-empty, non-comment line. List entries may be script paths or arbitrary shell.

setup-commands-file.description: Repo-relative path to a UTF-8 file with one shell command per line (same line splitting as setup-commands).

additional-instructions-fragments.description: Ordered fragment ids from the org fragments map; materialized before inline additional-instructions.

inputs.description: Overrides for agentic workflow inputs (kebab-case keys). Values may be scalars or *-file paths.

setup-commands.description: Inline shell commands (string or list). Multiline strings are split into one command per non-empty, non-comment line. List entries may be script paths or arbitrary shell.

setup-commands-file.description: Repo-relative path to a UTF-8 file with one shell command per line (same line splitting as setup-commands).

additional-instructions-fragments.description: Ordered fragment ids from the org fragments map; materialized before inline additional-instructions.

inputs.description: Overrides for agentic workflow inputs (kebab-case keys). Values may be scalars or *-file paths.

automations.description: repo-scheduled only: declared scheduled automations. Each entry uses instructions-file (recommended under .github/oblt-aw/scheduled/) or inline instructions; schedule-profiles and capabilities may be set here and/or in frontmatter (APM wins when both set).

policy.description: Automerge-only consumer policy (trigger labels, authors, forks). Ignored for other workflow ids. oblt-aw/ai/merge-ready is always an effective trigger label.

inner-workflows.description: Per control-plane wrapper basename assets when several wrappers share this workflow id. When the running basename matches, that block overrides the parent workflow block.

repoScheduledAutomation.description: One consumer-defined scheduled automation for obs:repo-scheduled. Provide instructions-file or instructions (not both).

id.description: Automation id (required for inline instructions; otherwise defaults to instruction file stem or frontmatter id).

instructions.description: Inline instruction Markdown body (optional YAML frontmatter). Mutually exclusive with instructions-file.

instructions-file.description: Repo-relative path to the instruction Markdown body. Recommended: .github/oblt-aw/scheduled/<name>.md. Mutually exclusive with instructions.

schedule-profiles.description: Wake lanes. Required here or in the instruction file frontmatter.

capabilities.description: Optional allowlisted capability ids (also accepted in file frontmatter).

automergePolicy.description: Optional automerge gates under workflows.automerge.policy. Omitted fields keep control-plane defaults.

trigger-labels.description: Extra PR labels that may trigger automerge. oblt-aw/ai/merge-ready is always included and cannot be removed.

mode.description: disabled: same-repo only. author-association: allow forks when author_association is listed.

author-associations.description: GitHub author_association values (for example MEMBER, OWNER) when mode is author-association.

mode.description: allow-list: control-plane bots plus repo allow-list. author-association: control-plane bots or matching association.

allow-list.description: Extra author logins when mode is allow-list (control-plane bots are always allowed).

author-associations.description: GitHub author_association values when mode is author-association.
